description: Set the display order of several categories in one call — "put Drinks first", "sort my categories alphabetically". Lowest sortOrder shows first, and ordering only applies among categories that share the same parent. Send every category whose position should change, with the ids from get_categories; ones you leave out keep their current order, which can leave two categories tied. It changes NOTHING but the order — for a rename or a move use update_category.

sortOrder.description: Position among its siblings, lowest first

name: hub_reorder_categories
